subject.title: fix(nvidia): sync recommended models with featured catalog

question: Should the NVIDIA provider accept the seven-selectable and five-deprecated full-catalog split for new setup and model-picker surfaces?
rationale: The code and proof support the split, but provider catalog defaults and auth-backed model selection are compatibility-sensitive surfaces that need maintainer/provider-owner acceptance before merge.

options.title: Accept Current Split
options.body: Land this PR after normal maintainer review because deprecated exact refs remain in the full catalog while new selection surfaces mirror NVIDIA's current featured feed.

options.title: Keep Deprecated Rows Selectable
options.body: Ask for a change that leaves old shipped rows visible in selection surfaces, trading current-feed alignment for maximum discoverability of older refs.

options.title: Pause For Provider Policy
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a broader NVIDIA deprecation policy before changing selectable defaults.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Split
recommendation.body: Land this PR after normal maintainer review because deprecated exact refs remain in the full catalog while new selection surfaces mirror NVIDIA's current featured feed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent merged ownership on the plugin/model catalog infrastructure that decides how provider catalog rows flow into selection surfaces.
